cases.description: When the ADDITIONAL section count is zero, getTSIG() should return null. The Message is constructed with a Header whose ADDITIONAL count is 0 and an empty ADDITIONAL section list.

When the ADDITIONAL section contains records but the last record is not of type TSIG, getTSIG() should return null. The Message is set up with a Header reporting a non‑zero ADDITIONAL count and the last Record in the ADDITIONAL list has a type different from Type.TSIG.

When the ADDITIONAL section contains at least one record and the last record is a TSIGRecord, getTSIG() should return that TSIGRecord. The Message is prepared with a Header whose ADDITIONAL count matches the size of the ADDITIONAL list, and the final element of that list is a TSIGRecord.
When the Message's header field is null, getTSIG() should throw a NullPointerException because it attempts to call header.getCount(...).
When the ADDITIONAL section array entry is null (sections[Section.ADDITIONAL] == null), getTSIG() should throw a NullPointerException when it tries to read from the list.
When the header reports a non‑zero ADDITIONAL count that is larger than the actual size of the ADDITIONAL list, getTSIG() should throw an IndexOutOfBoundsException while accessing l.get(count‑1).
When the ADDITIONAL list size matches the header count but the last element in the list is null, getTSIG() should throw a NullPointerException when it tries to read rec.type.

When the last record in the ADDITIONAL section has type TSIG but is not an instance of TSIGRecord (e.g., a plain Record with type set to Type.TSIG), getTSIG() should throw a ClassCastException during the cast to TSIGRecord.
When the Message's internal 'sections' array is null, getTSIG() should throw a NullPointerException because it attempts to index into a null array (sections[Section.ADDITIONAL]).

When the Message's 'sections' array is shorter than the required ADDITIONAL index (e.g., new List[Section.ADDITIONAL] creates an array whose length is less than Section.ADDITIONAL), getTSIG() should throw an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException while trying to access sections[Section.ADDITIONAL].
